steps.title: Prepare the persimmon
steps.body: Mix and set aside **1 cup persimmon pulp** and **1 tsp baking soda**.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.body: Mix well **1 egg**, **1 cup sugar** and **½ cup oil**.

steps.title: Sift the dry ingredients
steps.body: Sift together **1¾ cups flour**, **1 tsp salt**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **1 tsp nutmeg** and **1 tsp cloves**.

steps.title: Combine the batter
steps.body: Alternate adding pulp and flour mixtures to liquid mixture until it’s all well blended.

steps.title: Add the nuts and fruit
steps.body: Then add **1 cup chopped nuts** and **1 cup raisins or chopped dates**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Spread in a greased 9×13 pan and bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Cool for 5 minutes, then spread the glaze made from **1 cup powdered sugar** and **2 Tbsp lemon juice**.
